pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Exact .8 x 4 m boundary, ground origin at centre of Y=0 short end, tiling along +Y in 4m increments.
24 rosettes / 360 larger geometric leaflets over a continuous closed opaque dark-green canopy hull; modest berries and flowers retained.
Same closed canopy and mulch body in both LODs; all foliage alpha 1, opaque two-sided materials, no wind or collision.
Dark mulch: nominal sRGB 8/9/8, roughness .92, specular .06, barely raised normal detail. No sunlight baked into BaseColor.
1K BaseColor sRGB; Normal OpenGL +Y and ORM are linear non-color. Normals must be converted to Unreal convention by receiver.

pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Exact .8 x 4 m boundary, ground origin at centre of Y=0 short end, tiling along +Y in 4m increments.
Separate lowest LOD for always-loaded Instancing HLOD, Nanite disallowed; this is opaque closed ridge geometry, not a billboard.
Same closed canopy and mulch body in both LODs; all foliage alpha 1, opaque two-sided materials, no wind or collision.
Dark mulch: nominal sRGB 8/9/8, roughness .92, specular .06, barely raised normal detail. No sunlight baked into BaseColor.
1K BaseColor sRGB; Normal OpenGL +Y and ORM are linear non-color. Normals must be converted to Unreal convention by receiver.

parameters.notes: v003: closed opaque canopy under 24 larger rosettes; identical hull in LOD0 and separate non-billboard LOD3. Exact 0.8 x 4 m tile.

extra.construction: Each asset contains the same two closed connected prisms: black mulch and continuous green canopy. LOD0 adds 24 rosettes, 360 larger leaflets, 12 berries and 6 flowers. LOD3 is only those two prisms.
extra.materials: All nine slots opaque, two-sided, alpha 1. Slots 0=mulch, 8=canopy shared across both meshes; LOD3 uses these two slots only.
extra.scope: Offline only; no Unreal operation. Distance suite supplied by root; native HLOD assignment and material reconstruction remain operator work.
